## Weather, by site 

```{r desc_weat, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(flextable)
library(officer)
library(magrittr) 

# Load table
weat <- read.csv('- tables/desc_base_weat_loc.csv')

# Create flextable
ft_weat <- flextable(weat) %>%
  fontsize(size = 12) %>%        # font size
  autofit()                      # automatically adjust column widths

ft_weat
```


## Extreme weather definitions: Continuous

```{r desc_weat1, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Load table
df <- read.csv('- tables/desc_base.csv')

# Select data
count <- df[37:43, c(1, 3:4)]
cat <- cbind(df[44:50, 1:2], df[51:57, 1:2])
names(cat) <- c('IMD Variable', 'IMD Freq.', 'Clim. Variable', 'Clim. Freq.')

# Create flextable
ft_count <- flextable(count) %>%
  fontsize(size = 12) %>%        # font size
  autofit()                      # automatically adjust column widths

# Use officer to center and scale
ft_count
```

## Extreme weather definitions: Categorical

```{r desc_weat2, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Create flextable
ft_cat <- flextable(cat) %>%
  fontsize(size = 12) %>%        # font size
  autofit()                      # automatically adjust column widths

# Use officer to center and scale
ft_cat
```

## Statistical tests: IMD ANOVA tests

```{r desc_weat4, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}


# Load table
IMD_anova <- read.csv('- tables/desc_IMD_anova.csv')
CLIM_anova <- read.csv('- tables/desc_CLIM_anova.csv')


# Create flextable
ft_IMD_anova <- flextable(IMD_anova) %>%
  fontsize(size = 12) %>%        # font size
  autofit()                      # automatically adjust column widths

ft_CLIM_anova <- flextable(CLIM_anova) %>%
  fontsize(size = 12) %>%        # font size
  autofit()                      # automatically adjust column widths


# Use officer to center and scale
ft_IMD_anova
```

## Statistical tests: IMD ANOVA tests (interactions)

```{r desc_weat5, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}


# Load table
IMD_int <- read.csv('- tables/desc_IMD_interaction_tests.csv')
CLIM_int <- read.csv('- tables/desc_CLIM_interaction_tests.csv')

IMD_int <- IMD_int[IMD_int$p < 0.1, ]
CLIM_int <- CLIM_int[CLIM_int$p < 0.1, ]

# Create flextable
ft_IMD_int <- flextable(IMD_int) %>%
  fontsize(size = 12) %>%        # font size
  autofit()                      # automatically adjust column widths

ft_CLIM_int <- flextable(CLIM_int) %>%
  fontsize(size = 12) %>%        # font size
  autofit()                      # automatically adjust column widths


# Use officer to center and scale
ft_IMD_int
```
